tables/completed_ablation/transfer_indep.before_caption: \caption{Independent-source transfer on the same target heldout set, including every prespecified source and their combination. tables/strong_v3/effects.tex.before_caption: \caption{Does early evidence improve training allocation? Held-out scores use the same ten designs, ten laboratories, 800 full-client rounds and 160 development measurements per method. Uniform allocation gives every design 80 rounds; the evidence-guided loop screens all designs and fully validates six promoted candidates. Gain is evidence-guided minus uniform, in percentage points; W/T/L counts seed-level wins, ties and losses (total 4/8/0). Norman 95\% CI: [4.54, 17.73]; Tahoe: [$-$1.00, 7.46]. The separate DTI development replay is in Appendix A.}
tables/strong_v3/effects.tex.after_caption: \caption{Evidence-guided training allocation at a matched budget. Held-out scores use the same ten designs, ten laboratories, 800 full-client aggregation rounds and 160 aggregate development evaluations per method. Uniform allocation gives every design 80 rounds; the evidence-guided scheduler screens all designs for 20 rounds and restarts six promoted designs for 100-round training. Gain is evidence-guided minus uniform, in percentage points; W/T/L counts seed-level wins, ties and losses (total 4/8/0). Norman 95\% CI: [4.54, 17.73]; Tahoe: [$-$1.00, 7.46]. The separate DTI development replay is in Appendix A.}
